conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales and service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Amanda with Telecom Haiku. What brings you in?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Amanda. My phone is pretty old and dying. I'm looking at getting a new one. Do you guys sell phones?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We absolutely do. What kind of phone are you interested in? Apple or Android?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Android. I want something with a good camera and long battery life.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect. We have several models in stock. Want me to tell you about payment options?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Tech support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Chris here. What's the trouble?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Chris. My WiFi keeps dropping when I'm on video calls. It's really annoying because I'm on them a lot for work.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That could be interference or your router being overloaded. Are other people using your WiFi?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, my roommate also uses it. Could that be the issue?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Possibly. Try switching to the 5GHz band when you do calls. It handles video better with less interference.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Lisa from billing. What can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Lisa. I had a service for like three months but I'm cancelling it now. I need to make sure I'm not charged for next month.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Absolutely. I'm cancelling that service effective immediately.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Good. Will I get any kind of prorated refund for this month?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me calculate that. Yes, you'll get a partial refund of 8 dollars.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Robert here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Robert. I'm relocating for work next month and I need to update the service address for my account.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. I can update that. What's your new address?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 890 Oak Boulevard, Suite 4, Northtown.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Done. We'll have service available at that location.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Jennifer from tech support. What's going on?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Jennifer. My mobile signal has been really weak lately. I'm barely getting any bars, even outdoors. This is new.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me check if there's network maintenance happening in your area. Can you give me your location?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Sure. I'm in downtown area, near Fifth and Main Streets.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I see we're upgrading towers in that area. Signal should be back to normal within a week or two.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer retention.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Susan from retention. I understand you're considering other options?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, a competitor just called me with a really good offer. They're giving me triple the speeds for less money.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'd love to keep you. What specific offer did they make? Maybe we can work something out.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: They said 1000 Mbps for 79 dollars a month for a year.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That is competitive. Let me check with my supervisor.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Mark here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Mark. I'm interested in switching and I wanted to know if you guys can service my area. I'm in a rural location.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I can check that for you. What's your address or zip code?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 56789 Valley Road, out in Millcreek.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Emily from sales. What can I tell you about?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Emily. I'm wondering about your TV service. My cable provider just increased my rates and I'm frustrated.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We have some great TV packages that are very competitively priced. Do you watch a lot of cable?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Moderate amount. I like sports, news, and some movies. Just want to make sure you have the channels I want.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: David from billing. What can I do?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi David. I got my bill but I don't understand one of the line items. What's this equipment rental charge for?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's for your modem and router. You're renting them from us rather than owning them.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh I see. Can I just buy them instead of renting? I'd rather own them.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Absolutely. You can purchase them for a one-time fee and no more rental charges. Would you like to do that?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Patricia here. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Patricia. One of the cables coming into my house is loose and I'm worried about weather damage. Can someone come fix it?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Good catch. We can send a technician to secure that for you. When are you available?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I'm usually home on weekends. Saturday would work great.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect. I'm scheduling you for this Saturday morning.
